Dorsal margin strongly curved, ventral margin regularly convex and higly crenulated. Shell length less than height (mean SL/SH 70.8%). Valves rather inflated (mean SW/SH 63.3%). Sculpture consisting of 30-32 ribs, each with inverted U-shaped cross section with slightly rounded top and crenulated vertical sides, formed by intersection of strong radial ribs and concentric ribs. Interstices as wide as ribs or wider than ribs (especially posteriorly). Each rib wider on top than at base. Radial ribs gradually curving posteriorly when approaching ventral margin. Posteriormost six or seven ribs bearing sharp spines. Hinge teeth strong, ligament exterior and well visible. The laterals consist of upper and a lower lamella with a small tooth sandwiched in between. Hylleberg (2013) referred to this small tooth as Ral 2. Color exteriorly yellow to orange with darker commarginal bands and interiorly white with orange crenulated margins.
